Critically, no lab values contradict SIADH: euvolemia is confirmed clinically; urine osmolality is elevated (not low); serum osmolality is pending but expected to be low (consistent with hypo-osmolar hyponatremia); and there is no mention of hypokalemia, acidosis, or hypotension that would favor adrenal crisis. Pending cortisol/TSH/ADH will refine—but do not yet refute—the SIADH diagnosis.
